projects.title: SWAAD
projects.subtitle: Taste of Punjab
projects.description: A full-stack e-commerce platform and content management system built to manage products, product variants, categories, customers, authentication, and storefront data through a structured administrative workflow.
projects.role: Full-stack development — frontend, backend APIs, database modeling, and CMS workflows.
projects.problem: E-commerce operations require connected workflows for managing catalog data, product variants, customer information, and storefront content. These workflows need consistent data relationships and reliable validation across the application.
projects.solution: Built a Next.js-based CMS with a Node.js and Express backend, using MongoDB and Mongoose for persistence. Organized backend logic into controllers, services, and repositories to separate request handling, business rules, and database access.
projects.outcome: Developed a modular e-commerce CMS foundation with connected catalog, customer, and order workflows, designed to support ongoing storefront and administrative feature development.

projects.title: ScaleHealthTech Admin
projects.subtitle: Content Management System
projects.description: A CMS dashboard for managing website content and administrative workflows, including articles, tags, categories, article previews, and user management.
projects.role: Frontend development — Next.js, vanilla CSS, API integration, and CMS module enhancements.
projects.problem: Content management requires organized workflows for creating and managing articles, categorizing content, previewing published material, and handling user administration.
projects.solution: Enhanced CMS modules for article management, tags, categories, article previews, and user management using Next.js and vanilla CSS. Integrated APIs to connect frontend interfaces with backend functionality.
projects.outcome: Improved content management workflows and administrative interfaces, making it easier to manage structured website content and related operations.

projects.title: ScaleHealthTech
projects.subtitle: Healthcare Technology Website
projects.description: A healthcare technology website enhanced with improved service pages, search engine optimization, and a more refined frontend experience.
projects.role: Frontend development — Next.js, vanilla CSS, service page enhancements, SEO improvements, and API integration.
projects.problem: Service pages need to communicate offerings clearly, provide a consistent user experience, and follow SEO best practices to improve discoverability in search engines.
projects.solution: Enhanced website service pages and contributed to overall SEO improvements, alongside frontend development using Next.js and vanilla CSS and API integration where required.
projects.outcome: Improved service page presentation and strengthened the website's SEO implementation, supporting a clearer user experience and better search visibility.
